title: Even Squares
statement: Implement `solve(items)`. Return the sum of squares of the even integers in `items`. Do it in one pass without building a temporary list of the squares. Zero is even. An empty list or a list of odds returns 0.
constraints: items is a list of integers
hints: A generator expression or a running total both avoid the temporary list.
n % 2 == 0 selects evens, including zero and negative evens.
Square by multiplying the number by itself.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: The sum does not need the squares to exist as a list.

editorial: The sum does not need the squares to exist as a list. A running total is linear time and constant extra memory. Materializing the squares is also correct and spends memory the caller never sees.
reference_solution:
def solve(items):
    return sum(n * n for n in items if n % 2 == 0)
